<!-- pr-reviewer: 90e3be044ebc84a926e1f57433662b08c8844f0b -->
Reviewed on the cheap tier at the maintainer's instruction. The feature is display-only, but the PR edits the generators' error path in camcraft-motion, which is under AGENTS.md's safety floor; this pass checks above all that no generator's OUTPUT changed. If it finds any change to what a generator computes, that needs the high tier.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No generator output changed (checked below). The ghost never reaches the toolpath, simulation, verify, program gate or post. Two latent notes and one body wording request are non-blocking.

Reviewed head 90e3be04 trial-merged with origin/main bdd29e00 (clean, no conflicts).

### What looks good
- Every touched generator changes only its refusal branch: `Err(e)` becomes `Err(e).with_ghost(&path)`. The success path, the check order and the messages are unchanged.
- `Ghost::of` caps at 100,000 moves, says `truncated`, and drops any ghost with a non-finite move. Its `Debug` prints only its size.
- The ghost lives only on the error and `State::feedback_ghost`. `refusal_ghost()` retires it with the refusal. The draw path borrows it, so nothing is cloned per frame.
- Drawing uses the palette's gouge colour, dimmed, with no new hard-coded colour literals. It is a single call site in `interact.rs`.
- The app pin asserts no cached path, status Never, the post refusing with "no toolpath yet" and `simulate_document` erroring.

### Item 1: generator output (per generator)
- `machining2d/bore.rs`, `circular.rs`, `contour.rs`, `contour_chain.rs`, `pocket.rs`, `slots.rs` (slot and trace): refusal path only.
- `machining3d/ladder.rs`: refusal path only.
- `multiaxis/rotary_offset.rs` (`develop`): refusal path only; uses `without_ghost`, so the wrap-space moves are not carried.
- `plunge_law.rs` (`audit_as`, `audit_bar`): refusal path only. The `Ok` arm is untouched.
- `app/operation/plunge_solid.rs` (`face_air_entry`): equivalent. Old `Invalid`/`At` arms and `other => other` become `map_msg` plus `map`, with the same results for the only variants `audit` returns.
- No `*.cl`, `*.nc` or golden file in the diff (`git diff --stat` on those paths is empty).

Confirmed: item 1 holds.

### Item 2: a ghost is never a toolpath
- The ghost is carried on `GenError::Ghosted` and `CommandError::MachiningGhost` only. It is never written to the operation's cache, and `run_job` maps it with `map_ghost` only.
- The pin `refusal_ghost::an_op_with_a_ghost_has_no_toolpath_and_the_post_and_the_sim_refuse_it` asserts `toolpath_of` is None, status Never, the post containing "SLT: no toolpath yet", and `simulate_document` erroring. It covers each of the three.
- Matches on variants: the new variant falls into the same arm as the plain refusal in every fallback I found (`generate.rs` `Empty`-only fallbacks, `Err(e) => return Err(e)` passes), so no fallback is skipped or newly taken.

Confirmed: item 2 holds, with two latent notes below.

### Build and tests (trial merge with origin/main, CARGO_TARGET_DIR per review)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- ghost gen_error` | ok, 8 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test refusal_ghost` | ok, 2 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test ruling` | ok, 10 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test refusal_ghost` | ok, 4 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test refusal_location` | ok, 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test warned_moves` | ok, 2 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test center_cut_owed` | ok, 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test area_controls -- centre_cut center_cut` | ok, 1 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test center_cut_multiaxis` | ok, 6 passed (about 50 s) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- refusal_ghost refusal_focus path_lines` (from `crates/ui`) | ok, 11 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the `--ignored` heavy lanes, the release tier, the full quick-gate suites (only the touched and centre-cut binaries), and the ui snapshot suites (by law). The on-screen look was not hand-checked, and the GUI was not launched.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/app/src/operation/cross_spindle.rs:182-199` (`in_world`): `GenError::Ghosted` falls through `other => other`, so the message is not rewritten by `fix` and the spot is not shifted to world. Unreachable today, since the drilling kernel never calls `with_ghost`. If a ghost-carrying generator is ever routed through here, handle `Ghosted` with `map_msg` and `map_location`/`map_ghost`.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/picks.rs:117-120` (`door_refusal`) matches `GenError::Invalid` only. A `Ghosted` refusal with the same sentence would miss it. Both sentences are produced by app code without `with_ghost`, so nothing changes today. Matching on `to_string()` or on both variants would make this robust.
3. Light ground: `crates/ui/src/refusal_ghost.rs` `ghost_colour` darkens `pal.gouge` by 0.7 toward black. `path_lines` uses `ground_ink::dimmed(..., ground)` so a dimmed path fades toward the ground on a light viewport (#698). The palette is ground-aware, but the ghost does not use that dimming, and no light-ground contrast test covers it. Please check it by eye on the light theme.
4. Body wording (`Fixes #261`): the body says this covers the issue's whole ask. The decisions file (`docs/decisions/261-refusal-ghost.md`) lists generators that still carry no ghost (pre-build refusals, drill and hole doors, Rotary Offset's wrap-space ladder, early-return generators). Those refusals show no partial path. Since part of the ask is not met, `Refs #261` would be more accurate, or the body should name those gaps. A body edit is enough; no code change needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
